title: Home Depot reshuffles leadership to accelerate tech innovation
excerpt: The company is consolidating tech teams under the leadership of its new EVP and CTO as part of this effort.
content_html:
This story was originally published on CIO Dive. To receive daily news and insights, subscribe to our free daily CIO Dive newsletter.

Dive Brief:

  • The Home Depot is restructuring its technology team to align with broader organizational changes it is making to accelerate innovation and capture a greater share of its market, it announced last week. 

  • The company moved its store, supply chain and Pro product tech teams under the leadership of Franziska Bell, who joined the retailer as EVP and CTO in March. "I've always believed that the most powerful technology is the kind you don't notice, because it's busy behind the scenes making your life easier," Bell said at the time. 

  • Home Depot developed three strategic customer experience pillars for the reorganization, focused on streamlining core offerings, improving its interconnected shopping experiences and growing its professional home improvement base. The technology goals and updated leadership structure support the company's growth strategy, the announcement said.

Dive Insight:

Retailers are searching for ways to elevate customer experience and use technology to drive growth while navigating uncertain market conditions and economic headwinds.

The restructuring aims to capture a greater share of the home improvement market, and "enable smarter, faster innovation and create a more seamless customer experience for DIY and Pro customers," CEO Ted Decker said in a statement. 

In January, the company cut 800 jobs at its Atlanta store support center, most of which were focused on its technology organization. 

Although Home Depot declined to provide more details about technology's role in its organizational realignment, the March announcement of Bell's appointment said she would focus on enterprise-wide integration of agentic AI and machine learning to "create a seamless, interconnected and data-driven experience for The Home Depot's associates, DIYers and Pro customers."

Home Depot has worked to adopt and scale AI tools over the past few years, including the launch of Magic Apron, a suite of generative AI tools aimed at improving customer experience. An expanded partnership with Google Cloud brought more capabilities earlier this year.

The company further expanded its digital hub in March, adding capabilities for professional builders, remodelers and renovators. The platform allows real-time delivery tracking of bulky building materials and can connect to the company's Material List Builder AI tool.  

Technology has also played a role in the company's efforts to streamline customer shopping experiences online and in stores, Ann-Marie Campbell, senior EVP of U.S. stores and operations, said during the company's Q1 earnings call in May. 

"We have focused specifically on ensuring we have the right leadership and technology capabilities in place to simplify the operational demand on our stores and improve the speed and experience for our customers," Campbell said on the call.

content_html_zh:
本文最初发表于 CIO Dive。 要接收每日新闻和见解，请订阅我们免费的每日 CIO Dive 时事通讯。

潜水简介：

  • 家得宝上周宣布，正在重组其技术团队，以适应更广泛的组织变革，以加速创新并占领更大的市场份额。
  • 该公司将其商店、供应链和专业产品技术团队转移到 Franziska Bell 的领导下，后者于 3 月份加入该零售商，担任执行副总裁兼首席技术官。 “我一直相信，最强大的技术是你没有注意到的技术，因为它在幕后忙碌，让你的生活变得更轻松，”贝尔当时说道。
  • 家得宝为重组制定了三大客户体验战略支柱，重点是精简核心产品、改善互联购物体验以及发展专业家居装修基础。 公告称，技术目标和更新的领导结构支持公司的增长战略。

潜水洞察力：

零售商正在寻找提升客户体验并利用技术推动增长的方法，同时应对不确定的市场条件和经济逆风。

首席执行官 Ted Decker 在一份声明中表示，此次重组旨在占领家居装修市场的更大份额，并“实现更智能、更快速的创新，为 DIY 和专业客户创造更无缝的客户体验”。

1 月份，该公司在亚特兰大商店支持中心裁员 800 人，其中大部分集中在技术部门。

尽管家得宝拒绝提供有关技术在其组织重组中的作用的更多细节，但贝尔在 3 月份的任命公告中表示，她将专注于代理人工智能和机器学习的企业范围内整合，以“为家得宝的员工、DIY 者和专业客户创造无缝、互连和数据驱动的体验。”

过去几年，家得宝一直致力于采用和扩展人工智能工具，包括推出 Magic Apron，这是一套旨在改善客户体验的生成式人工智能工具。 今年早些时候，与 Google Cloud 扩大了合作伙伴关系，带来了更多功能。

该公司于三月份进一步扩大了其数字中心，为专业建筑商、改造商和翻新商增加了功能。 该平台可以实时跟踪大型建筑材料的交付情况，并可以连接到该公司的Material List Builder AI工具。

美国商店和运营高级执行副总裁安-玛丽·坎贝尔 (Ann-Marie Campbell) 在该公司 5 月份第一季度财报电话会议上表示，技术在公司简化在线和商店客户购物体验的过程中也发挥了作用。

坎贝尔在电话中表示：“我们特别注重确保我们拥有适当的领导力和技术能力，以简化我们商店的运营需求并提高客户的速度和体验。”
